book: Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs — Selected Testaments

1: My children, love one another, and do not envy the gifts of your brothers. For envy has divided the whole world, and jealousy has brought down many strong men. Love covers the multitude of sins, and the covering is not a hiding but a healing — and the healed are many, and the healed do not remember the wound.
[Testament of Simeon 3:2-4 — The counsel of patience]

I was a man of fierce spirit, and I repented of it in my old age, and I counsel you: flee anger, for anger is a blind guide that leads to a cliff it cannot see. Patience is the eye of the soul; anger is the hand over the eye.
2: My children, love work, and do it gladly, for idleness is the field where every weed grows. I have been a farmer all my days, and I have never been poor, and I have never been ashamed — and the secret is not the soil but the cheerfulness, for God loves a cheerful farmer as He loves a cheerful giver.
[Testament of Zebulun 4:1-3 — The fisher of men]

I was a fisherman, and I learned the sea's patience: cast the net, and wait, and do not curse the empty water, for the fish are God's and He gives them in His season. And I say to you: cast your goodness into the world like a net, and do not ask where it lands, for the Lord of the sea sees every cast.
3: You see, my children, the reward of long-suffering. If you pursue it with patience, the Lord will raise you from every pit, and the pit you are raised from becomes the well you draw from for others. I forgave my brothers while I had the power to destroy them — and that forgiveness was the first day of my true kingship.
[Testament of Benjamin 3:3-5 — The end of the book]

And Joseph said to his brothers: Do you think I forget that you sold me? I forget it the way the sea forgets the river — by becoming it. Love your enemies as I loved you, and you will find that enemies are a word for brothers you have not forgiven yet. The Lord is witness: I have never had a judge but His mercy, and His mercy has never failed me — and it will not fail you.
